```{r}
plotting_data <- brca1_df %>%
  drop_na(function_score, ESM.1v)

# 1. Load PDB (Ensure this path is correct)
pdb_path <- "~/Downloads/AF-P38398-F1-model_v6.pdb"
pdb <- read.pdb(pdb_path)

# 2. Define Active Sites
active_site_resnos <- c(
    24,27,39,41,44,47,61,64,           # RING
    3,6,7,8,10,11,14,15,17,18,21,22,38,76,77,78,79,81,82,85,88,89,92,93,96,97,
    1654, 1655, 1656, 1657, 1658, 1690, 1691, 1696, # BRCT
    1698,1699,1700,1701,1702,1740,1741,1773,
    1774,1775,1811,1813,1836,1839
)

# 3. Get Active Site Coordinates (Using the CORRECT 'string' argument)
# This was likely the missing piece in your previous environment
site_inds <- atom.select(pdb, resno = active_site_resnos, string = "noh")
site_xyz <- pdb$xyz[site_inds$xyz]

# Check immediately
if (length(site_inds$atom) == 0) {
  stop("STOP: Active site atoms are 0. The Code will not work.")
} else {
  print(paste("Active Site Loaded: Found", length(site_inds$atom), "atoms."))
}

# 4. Redefine the Function (The Robust Version)
calc_min_heavy_dist <- function(res_num, pdb_obj, site_coords) {
  
  # Bio3D is strict: 'resno' must be numeric. 
  # We force it here to fix the error you saw in Test B.
  res_num <- as.numeric(as.character(res_num))
  
  # Use 'string = "noh"' (The fix confirmed by Test A)
  target_inds <- atom.select(pdb_obj, resno = res_num, string = "noh")
  
  # Safety catch for missing residues
  if (length(target_inds$atom) == 0) return(NA)
  
  # Calculate
  target_xyz <- pdb_obj$xyz[target_inds$xyz]
  t_mat <- matrix(target_xyz, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  s_mat <- matrix(site_coords, ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  return(min(dist.xyz(t_mat, s_mat), na.rm = TRUE))
}

# 5. Run Calculation
unique_positions <- unique(plotting_data$mutation_position)

print("Starting calculation loop...")

dist_vals <- sapply(unique_positions, function(x) {
  calc_min_heavy_dist(x, pdb, site_xyz)
})

# 6. Map Back Safely
# explicitly name the vector to ensure matching works
names(dist_vals) <- as.character(unique_positions) 

# Assign based on character matching
plotting_data$min_dist_to_site <- dist_vals[as.character(plotting_data$mutation_position)]

# 7. Final Result
print(paste("Final NAs:", sum(is.na(plotting_data$min_dist_to_site))))
head(plotting_data$min_dist_to_site)

# If NAs remain, it means those specific residues are missing from the PDB structure 
# (common in loop regions), which is normal.
# Filter out NAs (residues not found in PDB structure)
plotting_data <- plotting_data %>% filter(!is.na(min_dist_to_site))
nrow(plotting_data) #1837

# --- ANALYSIS 1: VARIANCE PARTITIONING (THE "DELTA") ---
# Model A: Stability Alone
mod_stab <- lm(function_score ~ ddG_pred, data = plotting_data)
r2_stab <- summary(mod_stab)$r.squared

# Model B: Stability + ESM1v
mod_full <- lm(function_score ~ ddG_pred + ESM.1v, data = plotting_data)
r2_full <- summary(mod_full)$r.squared

r2_delta <- r2_full - r2_stab

# PRINT THESE NUMBERS FOR YOUR TEXT
print(paste("Variance explained by Stability (R2):", round(r2_stab * 100, 1), "%"))
print(paste("Variance explained by Stability + ESM (R2):", round(r2_full * 100, 1), "%"))
print(paste("The Delta (Biological Signal):", round(r2_delta * 100, 1), "%"))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
model_signal <- loess(ESM.1v ~ ddG_pred, data = plotting_data, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")
plotting_data$Signal_Residual <- residuals(model_signal)

# Exp residual: What part of SGE is NOT stability?
model_exp <- loess(function_score ~ ddG_pred, data = plotting_data, span = 0.7, family = "symmetric")
plotting_data$Exp_Residual <- residuals(model_exp)


# --- Calculate Statistics for the Text ---
# Correlation
spearman_val <- cor(plotting_data$Signal_Residual, plotting_data$Exp_Residual, 
                    method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

# Linear Model P-value (To support "significant positive slope")
lm_model <- lm(Exp_Residual ~ Signal_Residual, data = plotting_data)
lm_summary <- summary(lm_model)
p_value <- lm_summary$coefficients[2, 4] # Extract slope P-value

# Format the subtitle text dynamically
# If P is very small, use scientific notation
p_label <- ifelse(p_value < 2.2e-16, "P < 2.2e-16", sprintf("P = %.2e", p_value))
stats_subtitle <- sprintf("Spearman rho: %.3f | Slope %s", spearman_val, p_label)

# --- 3. Plot P1: Raw Comparison ---
p1 <- ggplot(plotting_data, aes(x = ESM.1v, y = function_score)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = clinvar_group, color = clinvar_group, alpha = clinvar_group), size = 2.5) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Pathogenic" = 17, "Benign" = 16, "Other" = 16)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Other" = "grey70", "Benign" = "#1B9E77", "Pathogenic" = "#D95F02")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Other" = 0.5, "Benign" = 0.9, "Pathogenic" = 0.9), guide = "none") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "BRCA1 - Raw Scores",
    subtitle = sprintf("Spearman's rho = %.3f", 
                       cor(plotting_data$ESM.1v, plotting_data$function_score, method="spearman", use="complete.obs")),
    x = "Predicted Pathogenicity (ESM1v)",
    y = "Experimental Function (SGE)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") 

# --- 4. Plot P2: Residual Comparison (The Main Argument) ---
p2 <- ggplot(plotting_data, aes(x = Signal_Residual, y = Exp_Residual)) +
  # Add Quadrant Lines to highlight the "Allosteric Concordance" (Bottom-Left)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(aes(shape = clinvar_group, color = clinvar_group, alpha = clinvar_group), size = 2.5) +
  
  # Linear Regression Line (The "Significant Positive Slope")
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", size = 1) +
  
  # Scales
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Pathogenic" = 17, "Benign" = 16, "Other" = 16)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Other" = "grey70", "Benign" = "#1B9E77", "Pathogenic" = "#D95F02")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Other" = 0.5, "Benign" = 0.9, "Pathogenic" = 0.9), guide = "none") +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Stability-independent Effects",
    subtitle = stats_subtitle, # Uses the calculated P-value < 2.2e-16
    x = "ESM1v - TMPNN Stability",
    y = "SGE - TMPNN Stability",
    shape = "ClinVar", color = "ClinVar"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p3 <- ggplot(plotting_data, aes(x = ddG_pred, y = function_score)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = clinvar_group, color = clinvar_group, alpha = clinvar_group), size = 2.5) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c("Other" = "grey70", "Benign" = "#1B9E77", "Pathogenic" = "#D95F02")) +
```

```{r}
transform_score <- function(x, invert_scale = FALSE) {
  ranks <- rank(x, ties.method = "average")
  min_r <- min(ranks, na.rm = TRUE); max_r <- max(ranks, na.rm = TRUE)
  norm <- if(max_r == min_r) rep(0, length(ranks)) else (ranks - min_r) / (max_r - min_r)
  if(invert_scale) return(1 - norm) else return(norm)
}

plotting_data_fil <- plotting_data_fil %>%
  drop_na(function_score, ESM.1v) %>%
  mutate(
    # Normalize: 0 = WT, 1 = Pathogenic
    SGE_norm = transform_score(function_score, invert_scale = TRUE),
    ESM_norm = transform_score(ESM.1v, invert_scale = TRUE),
    Comp_residual_norm = transform_score(Signal_Residual, invert_scale = TRUE),
    Exp_residual_norm = transform_score(Exp_Residual, invert_scale = TRUE),
    # Delta: Positive = SGE is higher (Under-predicted/MAVE-damaging)
    #        Negative = VEP is higher (Over-predicted/VEP-damaging)
    Delta_Pathogenicity = SGE_norm - ESM_norm
  )

plotting_data_fil
```

```{r}
range(plotting_data_fil_residue$min_dist_to_site)

plot_ready <- plotting_data_fil %>%
  dplyr::select(min_dist_to_site, Delta_Pathogenicity, Comp_residual_norm) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Comp_residual_norm", "Delta_Pathogenicity"), 
               names_to = "Residual_Type", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Abs_Value = abs(Value)) %>%
  # Bin data into 5 Angstrom chunks
  mutate(Dist_Bin = cut(min_dist_to_site, breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 4), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Dist_Bin)) %>% 
  group_by(Dist_Bin, Residual_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_Resid = median(Abs_Value),
    SE = sd(Abs_Value) / sqrt(n()), 
    Distance_Center = as.numeric(sub("\\((.+),.*", "\\1", Dist_Bin)) + 2.5
  )

# 2. Define Colors and Labels
# We define them explicitly here to ensure they match
my_colors <- c("Comp_residual_norm" = "#D55E00", "Delta_Pathogenicity" = "grey40")

# 3. Plot with Fixed Legend Order
p_binned <- ggplot(plot_ready, aes(x = Distance_Center, y = Median_Resid, color = Residual_Type)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Median_Resid - SE, ymax = Median_Resid + SE), width = 1.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +  # Note: use 'size' if you have older ggplot2
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  # --- THE FIX IS HERE ---
  scale_color_manual(
    values = my_colors,
    # 'breaks' determines the ORDER in the legend
    breaks = c("Comp_residual_norm", "Delta_Pathogenicity"), 
    # 'labels' determines the TEXT shown
    labels = c("ESM-1v-TMPNN ddGf residual (Signal)", "SGE-ESM-1v delta (Error)")
  ) +
  # -----------------------

  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Spatial Decay of ESM1v Signal vs. Error",
       subtitle = "BRCA1",
       x = "Minimum Heavy Atom Distance to Active/Binding Site (Å)",
       y = "Median Residual Magnitude",
       color = NULL) + # NULL removes the legend title "Residual_Type"
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.background = element_rect(fill=alpha('white', 0.8), color="black", size=0.2))

print(p_binned)
```

```{r}
# --- Merge with prediction data ---
merged_df <- plotting_data %>%
  filter(Signal_Residual<= 0)

nrow(merged_df) #928

# --- Residue-level median residuals ---
merged_df_residue <- merged_df %>%
  group_by(mutation_position) %>%
  summarise(
    loess_residual_avg = median(Signal_Residual, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_dist_to_site   = first(min_dist_to_site),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Exclude orthosteric sites for fitting ---
orthosteric_sites <- c(    24,27,39,41,44,47,61,64,           # RING
    3,6,7,8,10,11,14,15,17,18,21,22,38,76,77,78,79,81,82,85,88,89,92,93,96,97,
    1654, 1655, 1656, 1657, 1658, 1690, 1691, 1696, # BRCT
    1698,1699,1700,1701,1702,1740,1741,1773,
    1774,1775,1811,1813,1836,1839)

merged_df_residue_fil <- merged_df_residue %>%
  filter(!mutation_position %in% orthosteric_sites)

# --- Fit exponential model ---
exp_model <- nlsLM(
  abs(loess_residual_avg) ~ a * exp(-b * min_dist_to_site),
  data = merged_df_residue,
  start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1)
)
exp_model

# --- Prediction grid ---
x_vals <- seq(min(merged_df_residue$min_dist_to_site),
              max(merged_df_residue$min_dist_to_site), length.out = 200)

# --- Bootstrapping for confidence intervals ---
set.seed(11)
boot_params <- replicate(1000, {
  samp <- merged_df_residue[sample(nrow(merged_df_residue), replace = TRUE), ]
  fit <- try(nlsLM(abs(loess_residual_avg) ~ a * exp(-b * min_dist_to_site),
                   data = samp, start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1)), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) c(NA, NA) else coef(fit)
})
boot_params <- t(boot_params)[complete.cases(t(boot_params)), ]

boot_preds <- apply(boot_params, 1, function(p) p[1] * exp(-p[2] * x_vals))

fit_df_residue <- data.frame(
  min_dist_to_site = x_vals,
  loess_residual_pred = predict(exp_model, newdata = data.frame(min_dist_to_site = x_vals)),
  lower = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  upper = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
)

# --- Model parameter extraction and derived quantity ---
model_summary <- summary(exp_model)
coefs <- coef(exp_model)
se <- model_summary$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]

residue_a <- c(coefs["a"],
               coefs["a"] - 1.96 * se["a"],
               coefs["a"] + 1.96 * se["a"])

residue_b <- c(coefs["b"],
               coefs["b"] - 1.96 * se["b"],
               coefs["b"] + 1.96 * se["b"])

half_d <- log(2) / coefs["b"]
half_d_ci <- quantile(log(2) / boot_params[, "b"], probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
residue_half_d <- c(half_d, half_d_ci)

cat("Parameter a (intercept):", residue_a, "\n") 
cat("Parameter b (decay rate):", residue_b, "\n")   
cat("Half-distance (log(2)/b):", residue_half_d, "\n") 
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
# --- Annotate site types ---
merged_df_residue <- merged_df_residue %>%
  mutate(site_type = if_else(mutation_position %in% orthosteric_sites, "orthosteric", "non-orthosteric"))

# --- Plot ---
orange_labs <- orthosteric_sites
cyan_labs <- c()
all_labs <- union(orange_labs, cyan_labs)

p3 <- ggplot(merged_df_residue, aes(x = min_dist_to_site, y = abs(loess_residual_avg))) +

  # Unlabeled points
  geom_point(data = subset(merged_df_residue, !mutation_position %in% all_labs),
             aes(color = site_type), size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +

  # CI ribbon
  geom_ribbon(
  data = fit_df_residue,
  aes(x = min_dist_to_site, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  fill = "grey70",
  alpha = 0.3) +

  # Main fit line
  geom_line(
  data = fit_df_residue,
  aes(x = min_dist_to_site, y = loess_residual_pred),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "black")+


  # Labeled orange points
  geom_point(data = subset(merged_df_residue, mutation_position %in% orange_labs),
             shape = 16, size = 2, color = "orange") +
  # Labeled cyan points
  geom_point(data = subset(merged_df_residue, mutation_position %in% cyan_labs),
             shape = 17, size = 3, color = "cyan3") +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(merged_df_residue, mutation_position %in% cyan_labs),
                  aes(label = mutation_position), color = "black") +

  # Reference line
  geom_vline(xintercept = max(merged_df_residue %>% filter(site_type == "orthosteric") %>% pull(min_dist_to_site)),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "slategrey") +

  # Labels and theme
  labs(
    title = "BRCA1",
    subtitle = "",
    x = "Minimal distance to active site",
    y = "|Median ESM-1v-ddGf residual|"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("non-orthosteric" = "darkgreen", "orthosteric" = "orange")) +

  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("y = a * exp(-b * x)\na = %.4f\nb = %.5f", coefs["a"], coefs["b"]),
           size = 4, color = "black", hjust = 0)
```

```{r}
# --- Fit exponential model ---
exp_model <- nlsLM(
  abs(loess_residual_avg) ~ a * exp(-b * min_dist_to_site),
  data = merged_df_residue2,
  start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1)
)
exp_model

# --- Prediction grid ---
x_vals <- seq(min(merged_df_residue2$min_dist_to_site),
              max(merged_df_residue2$min_dist_to_site), length.out = 200)

# --- Bootstrapping for confidence intervals ---
set.seed(11)
boot_params <- replicate(1000, {
  samp <- merged_df_residue2[sample(nrow(merged_df_residue2), replace = TRUE), ]
  fit <- try(nlsLM(abs(loess_residual_avg) ~ a * exp(-b * min_dist_to_site),
                   data = samp, start = list(a = 1, b = 0.1)), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) c(NA, NA) else coef(fit)
})
boot_params <- t(boot_params)[complete.cases(t(boot_params)), ]

boot_preds <- apply(boot_params, 1, function(p) p[1] * exp(-p[2] * x_vals))

fit_df_residue2 <- data.frame(
  min_dist_to_site = x_vals,
  loess_residual_pred = predict(exp_model, newdata = data.frame(min_dist_to_site = x_vals)),
  lower = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025),
  upper = apply(boot_preds, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
)

# --- Model parameter extraction and derived quantity ---
model_summary <- summary(exp_model)
coefs <- coef(exp_model)
se <- model_summary$coefficients[, "Std. Error"]

residue_a <- c(coefs["a"],
               coefs["a"] - 1.96 * se["a"],
               coefs["a"] + 1.96 * se["a"])

residue_b <- c(coefs["b"],
               coefs["b"] - 1.96 * se["b"],
               coefs["b"] + 1.96 * se["b"])

half_d <- log(2) / coefs["b"]
half_d_ci <- quantile(log(2) / boot_params[, "b"], probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
residue_half_d <- c(half_d, half_d_ci)

cat("Parameter a (intercept):", residue_a, "\n") 
cat("Parameter b (decay rate):", residue_b, "\n")   
cat("Half-distance (log(2)/b):", residue_half_d, "\n") 
```
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
# --- Annotate site types ---
merged_df_residue2 <- merged_df_residue2 %>%
  mutate(site_type = if_else(mutation_position %in% orthosteric_sites, "orthosteric", "non-orthosteric"))

# --- Plot ---
orange_labs <- orthosteric_sites
cyan_labs <- c()
all_labs <- union(orange_labs, cyan_labs)

p4 <- ggplot(merged_df_residue2, aes(x = min_dist_to_site, y = abs(loess_residual_avg))) +

  # Unlabeled points
  geom_point(data = subset(merged_df_residue, !mutation_position %in% all_labs),
             aes(color = site_type), size = 2, alpha = 0.5) +

  # CI ribbon
  geom_ribbon(
  data = fit_df_residue2,
  aes(x = min_dist_to_site, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  fill = "grey70",
  alpha = 0.3) +

  # Main fit line
  geom_line(
  data = fit_df_residue2,
  aes(x = min_dist_to_site, y = loess_residual_pred),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "black")+


  # Labeled orange points
  geom_point(data = subset(merged_df_residue2, mutation_position %in% orange_labs),
             shape = 16, size = 2, color = "orange") +
  # Labeled cyan points
  geom_point(data = subset(merged_df_residue2, mutation_position %in% cyan_labs),
             shape = 17, size = 3, color = "cyan3") +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(merged_df_residue2, mutation_position %in% cyan_labs),
                  aes(label = mutation_position), color = "black") +

  # Reference line
  geom_vline(xintercept = max(merged_df_residue2 %>% filter(site_type == "orthosteric") %>% pull(min_dist_to_site)),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "slategrey") +

  # Labels and theme
  labs(
    title = "BRCA1",
    subtitle = "",
    x = "Minimal distance to active site",
    y = "|SGE-ddGf residual|"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("non-orthosteric" = "darkgreen", "orthosteric" = "orange")) +

  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
           label = sprintf("y = a * exp(-b * x)\na = %.4f\nb = %.5f", coefs["a"], coefs["b"]),
           size = 4, color = "black", hjust = 0)

p4
```

```{r}
plotting_data_res <- plotting_data  %>%
  group_by(mutation_position) %>%
  summarise(
    median_exp_residual = median(Exp_Residual, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_comp_residual = median(Signal_Residual, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_esm1v = median(ESM.1v, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_sge = median(function_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_thermompnn = median(ddG_pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_dist_to_site   = first(min_dist_to_site),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

unique(plotting_data_res$mutation_position)
```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=2}
plotting_data_res1 <- plotting_data_res %>% filter (mutation_position < 102)


df_long1 <- plotting_data_res1 %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(median_sge),
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(mutation_position,
              median_esm1v, median_thermompnn, median_sge, min_dist_to_site),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )  %>%
  mutate(mutation_position = factor(mutation_position,
                                   levels = sort(unique(mutation_position))))


ggplot(df_long1, aes(x = mutation_position, y = metric, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "", y = NULL, fill = "Value")
```
